messages:
alex_sales: Heads-up — new sealed-site ask from FinanceDept (federal contractor). Requirements: 3 GPUs, no outbound network ever, model blob signing with auditable custody, monthly security patch window, and an approval-ready pricing card. They also want a chain-of-custody manifest for any physical media. Thoughts?
tina_se: Feasible but a few pieces: we need to know exact model size + whether they accept our quantized artifacts or insist on customer-supplied weights. Custody manifest idea: we can produce a signed JSON manifest with transfer events.
josh_eng: Implementation sketch: build a signed artifact bundle (.tar.gz.sig) that contains: runtime container, runtime config, quantized model shards, SBOM.txt, and a manifest.json. Add a small verification shim (go binary) that validates signatures against our public key and writes a transfer record to local /var/redwood/custody.log. Example manifest field: \"transfers\":[{\"from\":\"redwood\",\"to\":\"customer\",\"ts\":\"2026-03-29T12:00:00Z\",\"sha256\":\"...\"}]
rachel_sre: Ops concerns: without egress we lose remote rollback. We can provide a USB-delta patch process with an idempotent updater and a pre/post acceptance script the customer runs. Recommend we require the customer to run the acceptance_sha check locally before applying. Also plan for an emergency airgap patch SOP.
vivian_security: Security asks: FIPS-mode crypto for signing, documented key custody, signed SBOM, and attestation that the build pipeline uses reproducible builds. We should offer an HSM-backed signing option for production POCs and a software-signing fallback for evaluation POCs. Also need to complete sections 3.2-3.5 of their vendor questionnaire (key rotation, compromise recovery, signing chain).
beth_legal: Legal: chain-of-custody records should be timestamped and notarizable on request. If they want notarization we may need an addendum. Also confirm export-control classification for the quantized weights.
alex_sales: Pricing nuance: propose free 60-day POC for sealed site with an $18k packaging/integration fee to cover artifact signing, SBOM generation, and one onsite support day (or remote guided transfer). Post-POC options: a) reserved-node annual commit, b) per-node annual license, or c) managed-storage + software maintenance. Need numbers for the deck.
tina_se: Technical pricing drivers: number of engineering days for HSM integration (estimate 5-10 days), offline acceptance harness (3 days), and custom quantization (if customer wants it, +4 days). USB-delta work + reproducible build verification adds 2-3 days.
josh_eng: For upgrade cadence: default = quarterly security + monthly critical hotfixes if on paid support. For monthly patches we will provide signed deltas and a checksum checklist. If they want fully automated rollback, they must host the acceptance tests locally (we supply a test harness tarball).
rachel_sre: Operational checklist we will hand over: pre-transfer checklist, verification commands, how to validate `sha256sum -c manifest.sha256`, how to run `redwood-verify --bundle bundle.tar.gz.sig`, and rollback steps. Also include runbook for disk wipe of node before next transfer.
vivian_security: Deliverables for SQ: reproducible-build log, signing key origin (HSM vs software), SBOM, threat-model summary, patch cadence commitments, and emergency contact matrix. I can draft answers but need build logs from eng.
beth_legal: Also add IP/ownership section in the POC SOW: confirm model weights remain customer-owned; binaries we ship are licensed.
alex_sales: Action items: Tina & Josh — produce a 1-page POC runbook + custody manifest template by Tue EOD. Vivian — start SQ draft and mark any showstopper items. Beth — flag notarization/addendum language. Ill prepare the pricing card.
deploy-bot: poc-ticket-#14002 created, assignees: @tina_se @josh_eng, due: 2026-04-06
tina_se: quick acceptance criteria Ill include: 1) `redwood-verify` exits 0 and writes custody record; 2) inference smoke tests pass against provided prompt-suite; 3) p95 latency < 200ms @ 8-token requests on target GPU; 4) SBOM present and signed.
josh_eng: also note: if customer insists on hardware HSM for signing, lead-time could add 4-6 weeks and cost varies. Offer virtual HSM for POC to reduce friction.
vivian_security: Flag: reproducible builds requirement could add non-trivial eng time depending on current CI. Ill highlight that in the SQ answers.
alex_sales: Great. If no pushback on timeline/cost Ill schedule a customer technical sync for Wed. If anyone sees a red-line, call it out now.
